dialogues.text: 환영합니다! 당신은 겉으로는 백수 은둔형 외톨이지만, 실은 세계를 구하는 숨겨진 영웅입니다.
dialogues.textEN: Welcome! You appear to be a NEET hermit, but you're actually a hidden hero saving the world.

dialogues.text: 화면을 탭하여 몬스터를 공격하세요. 골드와 경험치를 얻을 수 있습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Tap the screen to attack monsters. You can earn gold and experience points.

dialogues.text: 중요한 것은 정체를 들키지 않는 것입니다. 의심 게이지가 100%가 되면 게임 오버!
dialogues.textEN: The important thing is not to get caught. If the suspicion gauge reaches 100%, it's game over!

dialogues.text: 평범한 백수의 삶을 살던 당신. 어느 날 갑자기 이상한 힘에 눈뜨게 됩니다.
dialogues.textEN: You were living an ordinary NEET life. One day, you suddenly awakened to a strange power.

dialogues.text: 세계는 몬스터의 침략을 받고 있었고, 당신만이 그들을 막을 수 있었습니다.
dialogues.textEN: The world was being invaded by monsters, and only you could stop them.

dialogues.text: 하지만 가족과 주변 사람들에게는 비밀로 해야 합니다. 겉으로는 여전히 백수처럼 보여야 하니까요.
dialogues.textEN: But you must keep it secret from your family and those around you. You still need to appear as a NEET on the outside.

dialogues.text: 오빠, 오늘도 집에만 있을 거야? 취업 준비는 안 해?
dialogues.textEN: Brother, are you staying home again today? Aren't you preparing for job interviews?

dialogues.text: 휴... 맨날 쉰다더니. 그래도 건강은 챙기세요.
dialogues.textEN: Sigh... You always say you're resting. But at least take care of your health.

dialogues.text: 정말? 화이팅! 오빠라면 잘 할 수 있을 거야!
dialogues.textEN: Really? Fighting! I'm sure you can do it!

dialogues.text: 우리 아들, 밥은 먹었니? 엄마가 냉장고에 반찬 넣어뒀어.
dialogues.textEN: My son, have you eaten? Mom put some side dishes in the fridge.

dialogues.text: 그래, 잘 먹어야 힘이 나지. 천천히 취업 준비해도 괜찮아.
dialogues.textEN: Yes, you need to eat well to have energy. It's okay to take your time preparing for employment.

dialogues.text: 요즘 얼굴이 안 좋아 보이는데... 건강 챙겨야 해.
dialogues.textEN: You don't look well lately... You need to take care of your health.

dialogues.text: 어서 오세요! 오늘은 특별 세일입니다. 무엇을 찾으시나요?
dialogues.textEN: Welcome! There's a special sale today. What are you looking for?

dialogues.text: 좋은 선택입니다! 최고급 장비를 준비했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Good choice! I've prepared the finest equipment.

dialogues.text: 회복 물약과 버프 아이템이 준비되어 있습니다!
dialogues.textEN: Recovery potions and buff items are ready!

dialogues.text: 언제든 필요하시면 말씀해주세요!
dialogues.textEN: Feel free to let me know if you need anything!

dialogues.text: 크하하하! 인간 주제에 내 영역에 발을 들였구나!
dialogues.textEN: Kahahaha! A mere human dares to step into my domain!

dialogues.text: 하지만 너는 다른 인간들과는 다른 느낌이군. 재미있겠어!
dialogues.textEN: But you feel different from other humans. This will be interesting!

dialogues.text: 크윽... 이럴 수가... 인간에게 패배하다니...
dialogues.textEN: Grrr... This can't be... Defeated by a human...

dialogues.text: 호오? 인간이 여기까지 왔단 말인가. 제법이군.
dialogues.textEN: Oh? A human has made it this far. Not bad.

dialogues.text: 하지만 여기가 너의 무덤이 될 것이다!
dialogues.textEN: But this will be your grave!

dialogues.text: 이것이... 인간의 힘인가... 인정하지... 않는다...
dialogues.textEN: Is this... human power... I won't... acknowledge...

dialogues.text: 드디어 만났군. 나와 같은 은둔형 외톨이여.
dialogues.textEN: We finally meet. A fellow hermit like me.

dialogues.text: 하지만 은둔의 세계에는 오직 하나의 정점만이 존재할 수 있지!
dialogues.textEN: But there can only be one apex in the world of hermits!

dialogues.text: 이것이... 내 진정한 힘이다! ...라고 말하고 싶었지만, 너가 더 강했군.
dialogues.textEN: This is... my true power! ...I wanted to say, but you were stronger.

dialogues.text: 오빠... 요즘 좀 이상해. 밤에 몰래 나가는 것 같던데?
dialogues.textEN: Brother... you've been acting strange lately. It seems like you sneak out at night?

dialogues.text: 혹시... 이상한 일에 연루된 거 아니야?
dialogues.textEN: Could it be... you're involved in something strange?

dialogues.text: 그래? 건강에 좋긴 하지만... 밤 산책은 위험하니까 조심해.
dialogues.textEN: Really? It's good for your health, but... night walks are dangerous, so be careful.

dialogues.text: 비밀? 뭔가 숨기는 게 있구나! 더 의심스러워졌어!
dialogues.textEN: A secret? You're hiding something! Now I'm even more suspicious!

dialogues.text: 어? 정말로 말해줄 거야? 잠깐... 진지한 건가?
dialogues.textEN: Huh? Are you really going to tell me? Wait... are you serious?

dialogues.text: 경고! 정체를 밝히면 게임이 종료됩니다! 정말 진실을 말하시겠습니까?
dialogues.textEN: Warning! Revealing your identity will end the game! Do you really want to tell the truth?

dialogues.text: 하... 장난치지 마. 진지하게 물어본 건데.
dialogues.textEN: Hah... Don't joke around. I was asking seriously.

dialogues.text: 뭐... 뭐라고?! 오빠가 세계를 구하는 영웅이라고?!
dialogues.textEN: Wha... what?! You're a hero saving the world?!

dialogues.text: 축하합니다! 첫 환생을 완료했습니다. 더 강해진 모습으로 다시 시작하세요!
dialogues.textEN: Congratulations! You've completed your first rebirth. Start again with a stronger form!

dialogues.text: 레벨 50 달성! 이제 진정한 영웅의 길을 걷기 시작했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Level 50 achieved! You've now begun to walk the true path of a hero.

dialogues.text: 드래곤 킹을 처치했습니다! 당신의 이름이 전설이 되었습니다.
dialogues.textEN: You've defeated the Dragon King! Your name has become a legend.

dialogues.text: 밤이 되었습니다. 은둔형 외톨이에게는 밤이야말로 진정한 활동 시간!
dialogues.textEN: Night has fallen. For a hermit, night is the true time for activity!

dialogues.text: 낮입니다. 가족들이 깨어 있어 눈치를 봐야 합니다. 의심도가 더 빨리 증가합니다.
dialogues.textEN: It's daytime. Your family is awake, so you need to be careful. Suspicion increases faster.

dialogues.text: 뿌뿌뿌! 나는 무한히 분열한다! 나를 이길 수 있겠나?
dialogues.textEN: Bloop bloop! I divide infinitely! Can you defeat me?

dialogues.text: 뿌뿌... 무한이라고 했지만... 한계가 있었구나...
dialogues.textEN: Bloop... I said infinite, but... there was a limit after all...

dialogues.text: 오, 자네! 요즘 뭐하고 지내나? 취업은 됐나?
dialogues.textEN: Oh, you! What have you been up to lately? Did you get a job?

dialogues.text: 그래, 천천히 해도 괜찮네. 젊은이가 너무 조급해하지 말고.
dialogues.textEN: I see, it's okay to take it slow. Young people shouldn't be too hasty.

dialogues.text: 오, 정말? 그거 좋은 소식이군! 기대하고 있겠네!
dialogues.textEN: Oh, really? That's good news! I'll look forward to it!

dialogues.text: 여기까지 왔구나... 인간이여. 너는 선택받은 자다.
dialogues.textEN: You've come this far... human. You are the chosen one.

dialogues.text: 하지만 모든 것의 시작인 나를 넘어설 수 있겠는가?
dialogues.textEN: But can you surpass me, the origin of all things?

dialogues.text: 무한의 끝을 보여주마.
dialogues.textEN: I shall show you the end of infinity.

dialogues.text: 무한조차 끝이 있었구나... 축하한다, 진정한 은둔형 영웅이여.
dialogues.textEN: Even infinity had an end... Congratulations, true hermit hero.

dialogues.text: 당신은 모든 것을 극복하고 진정한 은둔형 영웅이 되었습니다. 하지만 일상은 여전합니다...
dialogues.textEN: You have overcome everything and become a true hermit hero. But daily life continues as usual...

dialogues.text: 오빠, 저녁 먹어! 엄마가 맛있는 거 해주셨어!
dialogues.textEN: Brother, come eat dinner! Mom made something delicious!

dialogues.text: 응, 지금 갈게!
dialogues.textEN: Okay, I'm coming!

dialogues.text: 오빠, 택배 왔어. 또 뭐 샀어? 돈은 있어?
dialogues.textEN: Brother, you got a package. What did you buy this time? Do you even have money?

dialogues.text: 필요한 거라... 오빠 요즘 뭔가 이상해. 방에서 이상한 소리도 나고...
dialogues.textEN: Something you need, huh... You've been acting strange lately. There are weird sounds from your room too...

dialogues.text: 뭐야, 비밀이야? 더 궁금해지잖아!
dialogues.textEN: What, is it a secret? Now I'm even more curious!

dialogues.text: 오빠! 나 시험 끝났어! 오늘은 좀 놀아줘~
dialogues.textEN: Brother! I finished my exams! Play with me today~

dialogues.text: 진짜?! 오빠 최고! 게임하자!
dialogues.textEN: Really?! You're the best! Let's play games!

dialogues.text: 에이... 맨날 바쁘다면서. 뭐가 그렇게 바빠?
dialogues.textEN: Aww... You always say you're busy. What are you so busy with?

dialogues.text: 오빠... 혹시 온라인 도박 같은 거 하는 건 아니지? 요즘 왜 그래?
dialogues.textEN: Brother... You're not doing online gambling or anything, right? What's wrong with you lately?

dialogues.text: 그래? 다행이다... 근데 진짜 요즘 이상해. 얼굴도 좀 안 좋고.
dialogues.textEN: Really? That's a relief... But you really are acting strange. You don't look well either.

dialogues.text: 당연하지! 오빠니까! 뭔가 힘든 일 있으면 말해, 알았지?
dialogues.textEN: Of course! You're my brother! If something's wrong, tell me, okay?

dialogues.text: 우리 아들, 오늘 날씨 좋은데 산책이라도 다녀오지 그래?
dialogues.textEN: Son, the weather is nice today. Why don't you go for a walk?

dialogues.text: 그래, 바깥 공기 쐬고 와. 엄마가 맛있는 거 해놓을게.
dialogues.textEN: Good, get some fresh air. Mom will make something delicious for you.

dialogues.text: 또 피곤해? 병원이라도 가봐야 하는 거 아니야?
dialogues.textEN: Tired again? Shouldn't you see a doctor?

dialogues.text: 이모가 우리 아들 어떻게 지내냐고 물어보시더라. 뭐라고 할까?
dialogues.textEN: Your aunt asked how you're doing. What should I tell her?

dialogues.text: 그래, 그렇게 말할게. 우리 아들 열심히 준비하고 있다고!
dialogues.textEN: Okay, I'll tell her that. Our son is working hard on preparation!

dialogues.text: 그래, 건강이 최고야. 천천히 해도 돼.
dialogues.textEN: Right, health is the most important. Take your time.

dialogues.text: 아들아, 요즘 밤에 안 자는 것 같은데... 무슨 일 있어?
dialogues.textEN: Son, you don't seem to be sleeping at night lately... Is something wrong?

dialogues.text: 무슨 걱정 있어? 엄마한테 말해봐.
dialogues.textEN: What are you worried about? Tell mom.

dialogues.text: 공부? 오, 그래? 열심히 하는구나! 근데 건강도 챙겨야지.
dialogues.textEN: Studying? Oh, really? You're working hard! But take care of your health too.

dialogues.text: 아들, 요즘 뭐 하고 지내? 취업 준비는 잘 돼가냐?
dialogues.textEN: Son, what have you been up to lately? How's the job preparation going?

dialogues.text: 그래, 내 아들 믿는다. 조급해하지 말고 차근차근 해.
dialogues.textEN: Good, I believe in you. Don't rush, take it step by step.

dialogues.text: 그래, 급할 거 없어. 아빠도 예전에 고생 많이 했거든.
dialogues.textEN: Right, no need to rush. Dad went through a lot back in the day too.

dialogues.text: 요즘 컴퓨터로 뭐 하냐? 게임만 하는 건 아니겠지?
dialogues.textEN: What are you doing on the computer lately? You're not just playing games, right?

dialogues.text: 오, 자기개발 중이구나! 좋아, 필요한 거 있으면 말해.
dialogues.textEN: Oh, working on self-improvement! Good, tell me if you need anything.

dialogues.text: 그래, 열심히 해라. 혹시 아빠 인맥 필요하면 말하고.
dialogues.textEN: Good, work hard. Let me know if you need any of dad's connections.

dialogues.text: 뭐야, 대답을 안 해? 뭔가 숨기는 거 있냐?
dialogues.textEN: What, no answer? Are you hiding something?

dialogues.text: 오늘 저녁에 치킨 시켜 먹을까? 뭐 먹고 싶어?
dialogues.textEN: Want to order chicken for dinner? What do you want to eat?

dialogues.text: 좋아! 가족이 같이 먹어야 맛있지!
dialogues.textEN: Great! Food tastes better when we eat together as a family!

dialogues.text: 뭐야, 입맛 없어? 요즘 잘 안 먹는 것 같은데...
dialogues.textEN: What, no appetite? You don't seem to be eating well lately...

dialogues.text: 배달 왔습니다! 여기 사인해 주세요.
dialogues.textEN: Delivery! Please sign here.

dialogues.text: 네! 좋은 하루 되세요!
dialogues.textEN: Yes! Have a nice day!

dialogues.text: 어... 네, 감사합니다? (왜 이러시지...)
dialogues.textEN: Uh... yes, thank you? (What's with this person...)

dialogues.text: 손님, 이거 세 번째 배달인데... 혹시 온라인 쇼핑 많이 하시나 봐요?
dialogues.textEN: Sir, this is the third delivery... You must do a lot of online shopping?

dialogues.text: 저도 집에서 많이 시켜요! 편하잖아요, 하하!
dialogues.textEN: I order a lot from home too! It's convenient, haha!

dialogues.text: ...네, 좋은 하루 되세요.
dialogues.textEN: ...Yes, have a nice day.

dialogues.text: 어서오세요~ 아, 손님 오늘도 오셨네요!
dialogues.textEN: Welcome~ Oh, you're here again today!

dialogues.text: 매일 같은 시간에 오시네요! 에너지 드링크 드릴까요?
dialogues.textEN: You come at the same time every day! Would you like an energy drink?

dialogues.text: (속으로) 왜 저렇게 눈을 피하지... 좀 이상한 사람인가?
dialogues.textEN: (Thinking) Why do they avoid eye contact... Kind of a strange person?

dialogues.text: 손님, 새벽 3시에 컵라면이랑 에너지 드링크... 야근하시나 봐요?
dialogues.textEN: Sir, cup noodles and energy drink at 3 AM... Working late?

dialogues.text: 열심히 사시네요! 화이팅이에요!
dialogues.textEN: You're working hard! Fighting!

dialogues.text: 아... 불면증이신가? 저도 가끔 그래요.
dialogues.textEN: Ah... Insomnia? I get that sometimes too.

dialogues.text: 야! 오랜만이다! 요즘 뭐 하고 지내?
dialogues.textEN: Hey! Long time no see! What have you been up to?

dialogues.text: 이것저것? 뭔가 숨기는 거 있지? 얼굴에 다 써있어!
dialogues.textEN: This and that? You're hiding something, aren't you? It's written all over your face!

dialogues.text: 오, 힘내라! 너 능력 있잖아. 분명 좋은 데 갈 거야!
dialogues.textEN: Oh, cheer up! You've got skills. You'll definitely land somewhere good!

dialogues.text: 바빠? 뭐가 그렇게 바빠? 우리 술이나 한 잔 하자!
dialogues.textEN: Busy? What's keeping you so busy? Let's grab a drink!

dialogues.text: 야, 진짜 괜찮아? 요즘 왜 이렇게 연락이 안 돼?
dialogues.textEN: Hey, are you really okay? Why have you been so hard to reach lately?

dialogues.text: 그래? 뭔가 있구나. 언제든 연락해, 알았지?
dialogues.textEN: Really? Something's going on. Contact me anytime, okay?

dialogues.text: 힘든 일 있으면 말해! 친구잖아. 내가 도와줄 수 있는 거면 뭐든!
dialogues.textEN: Tell me if you're going through a hard time! We're friends. I'll help with whatever I can!

dialogues.text: 어, 학생! 이 시간에 어딜 가는 거야?
dialogues.textEN: Hey, young man! Where are you going at this hour?

dialogues.text: 밤에 산책? 건강에 좋지. 조심해서 다녀!
dialogues.textEN: A walk at night? Good for your health. Be careful!

dialogues.text: 그래, 빨리 다녀와. 요즘 밤에 이상한 일이 많아.
dialogues.textEN: Okay, hurry back. There have been strange things happening at night lately.

dialogues.text: ...뭐야, 대답도 안 해? 수상하네.
dialogues.textEN: ...What, no answer? That's suspicious.

dialogues.text: 자네, 요즘 밤마다 나갔다 들어오던데... 무슨 일 있나?
dialogues.textEN: You've been going out every night lately... Is something going on?

dialogues.text: 아, 야간 알바? 열심히 사네! 젊을 때 고생은 약이야.
dialogues.textEN: Ah, a night job? You're working hard! Hardship in youth builds character.

dialogues.text: 운동? 좋지! 젊을 때 건강 챙겨야 해.
dialogues.textEN: Exercise? Good! You need to take care of your health while young.

dialogues.text: 사생활? 흠... 뭔가 수상하군. 지켜보고 있겠네.
dialogues.textEN: Privacy? Hmm... That's suspicious. I'll be keeping an eye on you.

dialogues.text: 후후... 그림자 속에서 살아가는 자여. 나와 같은 존재로군.
dialogues.textEN: Heh... One who lives in the shadows. A kindred spirit.

dialogues.text: 하지만 이 그림자의 세계에는 오직 하나의 어둠만이 존재할 수 있다!
dialogues.textEN: But in this realm of shadows, only one darkness can exist!

dialogues.text: 크윽... 네 그림자가... 나보다 더 짙구나...
dialogues.textEN: Ugh... Your shadow... is darker than mine...

dialogues.text: 밤의 지배자인 내 앞에 감히...! 너도 밤에 활동하는 존재인가?
dialogues.textEN: How dare you stand before me, the ruler of night...! Are you also a creature of the night?

dialogues.text: 그래도 용서할 수 없다! 밤은 오직 나의 것!
dialogues.textEN: Still, I cannot forgive you! The night belongs only to me!

dialogues.text: 밤새 활동하는 너의 끈기... 인정한다...
dialogues.textEN: Your persistence to stay active all night... I acknowledge it...

dialogues.text: 후후후... 사람들의 시선이 느껴지지? 모두 너를 보고 있어...
dialogues.textEN: Hehehe... Can you feel the stares? Everyone is watching you...

dialogues.text: 집 밖으로 나오다니 대단한 용기야. 하지만 여기서 끝이다!
dialogues.textEN: What courage to leave your house. But this is where it ends!

dialogues.text: 어떻게... 나를 극복하다니... 너는 진정한 용사야...
dialogues.textEN: How... could you overcome me... You are a true warrior...

dialogues.text: 에이, 내일 해도 되잖아... 오늘은 그냥 쉬어...
dialogues.textEN: Eh, you can do it tomorrow... Just rest today...

dialogues.text: 그냥... 누워있어... 일어나지 마... 침대가 널 부르잖아...
dialogues.textEN: Just... lie down... Don't get up... The bed is calling you...

dialogues.text: 으... 이 의지력은 어디서... 너 진짜 대단해...
dialogues.textEN: Ugh... Where does this willpower come from... You're truly amazing...

dialogues.text: 째깍째깍... 시간이 없다... 마감이 다가온다...
dialogues.textEN: Tick tock... Time is running out... The deadline approaches...

dialogues.text: 제출하지 못하면 모든 것이 끝이다! 크하하하!
dialogues.textEN: If you don't submit, everything is over! Mwahahaha!

dialogues.text: 이런... 벼락치기의 달인이구나... 인정한다...
dialogues.textEN: Oh my... A master of cramming... I acknowledge you...

dialogues.text: 새벽 2시. 배가 고프다. 냉장고를 뒤지면 가족들이 깰 수도 있다...
dialogues.textEN: 2 AM. You're hungry. Rummaging through the fridge might wake up your family...

dialogues.text: 닌자처럼 조용히 냉장고에서 음식을 꺼냈다. 아무도 눈치채지 못했다!
dialogues.textEN: Like a ninja, you quietly took food from the fridge. No one noticed!

dialogues.text: 참았다... 하지만 배고파서 집중이 안 된다.
dialogues.textEN: You held back... But you can't focus because you're hungry.

dialogues.text: 택배가 도착했습니다! 장비 강화 재료입니다.
dialogues.textEN: Package has arrived! Equipment enhancement materials.

dialogues.text: 오빠, 또 택배야? 요즘 무슨 택배가 이렇게 많아?
dialogues.textEN: Brother, another package? Why are there so many packages lately?

dialogues.text: 생활용품? 흠... 의심스럽긴 한데 알았어.
dialogues.textEN: Household items? Hmm... It's suspicious, but okay.

dialogues.text: 오, 쇼핑? 뭐 샀어? 나도 보여줘!
dialogues.textEN: Oh, shopping? What did you buy? Show me too!

dialogues.text: 오늘은 가족 다 같이 저녁 먹자! 오빠도 나와!
dialogues.textEN: Let's all have dinner together today! Come out!

dialogues.text: 가족과 즐거운 저녁 시간을 보냈다. 모두 행복해 보인다.
dialogues.textEN: You had a pleasant dinner with your family. Everyone looks happy.

dialogues.text: 쟤 요즘 왜 저래? 밥도 같이 안 먹으려고 하고...
dialogues.textEN: What's wrong with that kid lately? Not even eating meals together...

dialogues.text: 갑자기 정전이 됐다! 던전 탐험 중 연결이 끊어졌다!
dialogues.textEN: Sudden blackout! You got disconnected during dungeon exploration!

dialogues.text: 헉! 오빠! 정전이야! 무서워!
dialogues.textEN: Eek! Brother! Blackout! I'm scared!

dialogues.text: 오빠 든든하다! 진짜?
dialogues.textEN: You're so reliable, brother! Really?

dialogues.text: 던전? 뭔 던전? 오빠 게임 중이었어?!
dialogues.textEN: Dungeon? What dungeon? Were you playing a game?!

dialogues.text: 전화 통화 중 몬스터에 대해 말하고 있었는데, 엄마가 지나갔다...
dialogues.textEN: You were talking about monsters on the phone, and mom walked by...

dialogues.text: 몬스터? 무슨 몬스터? 뭐하는 거야?
dialogues.textEN: Monster? What monster? What are you doing?

dialogues.text: 또 게임? 하루 종일 게임만 하면 어떡해...
dialogues.textEN: Games again? What are you going to do playing games all day...

dialogues.text: 아, 영화? 요즘 재밌는 영화 많이 나왔어?
dialogues.textEN: Ah, movies? Are there many good movies out lately?

dialogues.text: 던전에서 입은 상처가 아직 남아있다. 가족들에게 들키면 안 된다...
dialogues.textEN: The wound from the dungeon is still there. Your family mustn't find out...

dialogues.text: 어머, 팔에 이게 뭐야?! 어디서 다친 거야?!
dialogues.textEN: Oh my, what's this on your arm?! Where did you get hurt?!

dialogues.text: 넘어졌다고? 병원 가봐야 하는 거 아니야?
dialogues.textEN: You fell? Shouldn't you go to the hospital?

dialogues.text: 모기? 이게 모기 물린 거라고? 거짓말하지 마!
dialogues.textEN: Mosquito? You're saying this is a mosquito bite? Don't lie!

dialogues.text: 완벽한 변명! 의심도가 크게 감소했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Perfect excuse! Suspicion significantly decreased.

dialogues.text: 변명이 의심스러웠습니다... 의심도가 증가합니다.
dialogues.textEN: The excuse was suspicious... Suspicion increased.

dialogues.text: 팁: 가족과 대화할 때는 최대한 평범하게 행동하세요!
dialogues.textEN: Tip: Act as normal as possible when talking to your family!

dialogues.text: 팁: 밤에 활동하면 의심도 증가율이 낮아집니다!
dialogues.textEN: Tip: Acting at night reduces the suspicion gain rate!

dialogues.text: 팁: 정체가 들키면 게임 오버! 의심도를 잘 관리하세요!
dialogues.textEN: Tip: If your identity is discovered, it's game over! Manage your suspicion well!

dialogues.text: 요즘 특별히 은둔형 영웅을 위한 상품이 많이 들어왔지!
dialogues.textEN: We've got a lot of special items for hermit heroes lately!

dialogues.text: 흠, 요즘 던전에 강력한 몬스터가 나타났다는 소문이 있어. 장비 점검해둬!
dialogues.textEN: Hmm, rumor has it that powerful monsters have appeared in the dungeons. Check your equipment!

dialogues.text: 업적 달성: 첫 번째 거짓말! 가족에게 처음으로 변명에 성공했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Achievement unlocked: First Lie! You successfully made your first excuse to your family.

dialogues.text: 업적 달성: 변명의 달인! 100번의 변명에 성공했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Achievement unlocked: Master of Excuses! You successfully made 100 excuses.

dialogues.text: 업적 달성: 올빼미! 밤 시간대에 100시간 활동했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Achievement unlocked: Night Owl! You've been active for 100 hours at night.

dialogues.text: 업적 달성: 가족의 시간! 의심도를 낮추면서 가족과 10번 대화했습니다.
dialogues.textEN: Achievement unlocked: Family Time! You talked to your family 10 times while lowering suspicion.
